feeds.title: Cate St.Hill Blog
feeds.description: Cate St Hill is a design and interior writer, blogger, stylist, and consultant based in south London, UK. She aims to show stylish spaces that are minimal yet feel authentic, honest, warm and inviting. With a strong belief that good design should be accessible to all, she set up her blog in 2011, sharing simple interior design for everyday living. Her blog is your interior resource for simple, stylish living that's curated with meaning, honesty, and intention.

feeds.title: Charis White
feeds.description: Charis White is an interior stylist and writer styling for editorial and advertising clients such as Homes and Gardens, M&S, Laura Ashley, and Sanderson. The blog covers interior design trends, ceramics architecture, home decor, furniture makeovers, garden makeovers, antiques, and more.

feeds.title: Unsustainable Magazine » Interior Design
feeds.description: Unsustainable' is a digital magazine consisting of carefully curated pieces of writing, photography, and occasionally video, all related to issues of sustainability and equality. Browse through the Interior design section and get inspiration for simple design for everyday living.

feeds.title: Brave New Eco Blog
feeds.description: Brave New Eco specialises in sustainable building and renovation design, driven by beauty and resourcefulness. They also provide consultations to improve the energy efficiency of existing homes and new projects.

feeds.title: DAM Portugal Blog
feeds.description: DAM is a Portuguese brand founded in 2013 that talks about design, craftsmanship, and industry. DAM is about high-quality Design Furniture and Accessories that tell stories. Designed with expertise and handcrafted with love in Portugal, the products combine traditional techniques and natural materials.

feeds.title: Motiv Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Anna McGary is an interior designer who makes sustainability the priority in her firm. With over a decade of experience in hospitality, Anna ensures that MOTIV Interiors provides exceptional customer service while specializing in incorporating sustainable design principles into every project. She shares her views, designs, and ideas on her blog.

feeds.title: Anooi Blog
feeds.description: Anooi is an interior design and content creation studio committed to shaping a nourishing relationship between people and nature through design. The blog is a space to get inspired and explore the relationship between design, people, and nature.

feeds.title: Barbulianno Design Blog
feeds.description: Vanja Barbul is the founder of Barbulianno and is an interior designer and photography enthusiast. Here at Barbulianno Design, our work is devoted to sharing ideas, tools, and resources to help you create an earth-friendly and peaceful home, a place where you feel safe, relaxed, and happy. By carefully choosing organic materials and textures, maximizing natural light, and bringing nature indoors, you can create a home that will love you back.

feeds.title: Annabode Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Annabode is a full-service residential interior design firm in Denver that creates socially-conscious, sustainable interiors. The blog topics cover sustainable home decor, eco-interior design, styling packages, and more.

feeds.title: Being
feeds.description: Being is a digital magazine and interior design studio. We focus on creating healthy, sustainable organic homes while minimizing our impact on the environment. We believe that through organic, conscious living and supporting ethical and sustainable practices, we will make a positive impact on our environment and our health.

feeds.title: Dujardin Design Blog
feeds.description: Dujardin Design Associates, Inc (DDA) creates distinctive interiors for some of the world's most discerning clientele. From the traditional to the more contemporary, from casual beach houses to chic city apartments, the firm's clean, refined aesthetic marries the finest furnishings, original art and antiques, sustainable materials, and natural finishes, with timeless style.

feeds.title: Sustainable Home Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kirsten Flynn, owner and principal designer at Sustainable Home. At Sustainable Home, we're committed to making sustainability a natural part of good interior design. To build homes with quality materials and create beautiful spaces with real life in mind.

feeds.title: Urban Re-Leaf Blog
feeds.description: Urban Re-leaf Home seeks to renew your home from the inside out. With an emphasis on sustainability and originality, each pillow cover is handcrafted with high-quality hemp to provide style and eco-conscious elegance to any room. At Urban Re-leaf Home, we believe that every room deserves at least one original piece to give it a bit of heart and soul.

feeds.title: Conscious Life & Style » Sustainable Home
feeds.description: Founded by Elizabeth Joy, Conscious Life & Style is a mindful digital media destination that creates resources to encourage a thoughtful lifestyle and to support pathways to personal, collective, and planetary well-being. Read the Sustainable home blog and curate a conscious and green home with these guides to eco-friendly furniture, home decor, and more.

feeds.title: The Home Green Blog
feeds.description: The Home Green Blog is a resource devoted to exploring all things related to sustainability and interior design. The Home Green is about recognizing the impact that design has in our everyday lives while striving to make choices that support our individual and collective homes. Check back regularly as team THC shares what it learns!
